meta.method: Read-only recursive scan of data/eras/*.json (excluding all.json) and db/**/*.json|*.geojson, excluding lens_* translations, db/border_drafts/ (unpublished drafts; published data only), db/legends/ and legend_spec.json (legend summaries: badges_present, badge_filter, per-entry badge copies), summary/handoff files (second_sources_for_historian.json, *summary*) and this output. Only values under real badge keys count: badge, badges, flags, flag, from_badges, to_badges (array or string). A value counts once if it equals or begins with a badge name (flags use 'SINGLE-SOURCE: <detail>'). Free text (basis_en, note, claim, etc.) is ignored. Attribution: the era file data/eras/<id>.json, a file named after an era id, a dict key equal to an era id, or an enclosing era/era_id/era_ids/eras/period_id field. Unlinked badges are not counted.

inline_method: Exact bracketed tags [NAME] or [NAME: note] for the 9 badge names in data/eras/*.json text fields (excluding all.json, badge keys and Arabic _ar/ar fields); a tag is not counted when the enclosing object already has the same structured badge. Not included in totals/grand_total.
source_types_method: Per era: distinct registry IDs in data/eras/<id>.json sources, each classified once from data/periods.json meta.sources fields (publisher/author, then url domain, ISBN, note as fallback). Totals sum era counts (an ID cited by several eras counts once per era); source_types_distinct_ids counts each ID once overall. Rules in db/build_badge_counts.py header; unclear IDs -> other.
